content.value: Eighty units of end item E are needed at the beginning of week 6. Three cases (30 units per case) of J have been ordered and one case is scheduled to arrive in week 3, one in week 4 and one in week 5. J must be ordered by the cases and B must be produced in multiples of 120 units, There are 60 units of B and 20 units of J now on hand. Lead times are two weeks each for E and B and one week for J. Prepare a MRP for component J.
